name: AWS EC2 P4d / P4de (NVIDIA A100 SXM4 40GB and 80GB)
region: us-east-1, us-west-2 on-demand; Capacity Blocks in us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2 only
price_basis: per A100 GPU-hour. p4de.24xlarge = 8x A100 80GB, on-demand $27.44705/instance-hr / 8 = $3.4309 (us-east-1 and us-west-2 identical). p4d.24xlarge = 8x A100 40GB, on-demand $21.95764/8 = $2.7447, Capacity Block $11.8/8 = $1.475; p4de Capacity Block $17.712/8 = $2.214. Fetched 2026-10-03.
notes: A100 remains the value entry point into AWS for anyone who does not need Hopper. p4d carries the $0.00 sentinel too, so treat on-demand p4d as allocation-only and buy the Capacity Block. The 2026-10-07 forward schedule LOWERS P4d Capacity Blocks to $1.696 per A100-hour and P4de to $2.546 - the one AWS accelerated SKU in this slice that is scheduled to get cheaper. P4 Capacity Blocks are offered in only three regions (n. Virginia, Ohio, Oregon), less regional choice than P5. Prices exclude the OS fee ($0 on Linux, $1.0368/instance-hr for RHEL on a 24xlarge) and all data egress. Note p4de is the 80GB part and p4d the 40GB part - different accelerators, not two sizes of one instance, so do not average them.
